Honda has facelifted the Elevate. But has it made the right changes?
A panoramic sunroof. Ventilated seats. A redesigned dashboard. Connected lights. The Honda Elevate now has more of the things buyers expect from a modern SUV.
But the engine is still the same. The gearbox is still the same. And the fundamentals that made the Elevate a genuinely good driver's car haven't changed.
So why does it struggle to stand out in a segment dominated by the Hyundai Creta, Kia Seltos and a growing list of rivals?
